$^{1}$香港最近幾個星期的局勢有很大的挑戰,.
因著修改逃犯條例的迴響,反送中大遊行,民間聲音,市民,教育界,甚至媽媽,律師,大律師,中學,大學,小學,信徒等等,他們都紛紛反對..
但特首林鄭月娥對有關要求和回應,雖然曾經以書面和親自致歉,都被泛民,民陣及青年人不收服..
但林鄭月娥的回應反映了她不會辭職,也不會設立獨立委員會調查,仍然不會撤回..
所以很多人都認為她太官僚,太官腔,甚至有人說她正在撥火,明天7月1日香港還有一個更大的遊行,問題會繼續延續下去..
有人認為林鄭月娥和政府實在太離地,今天作為基督徒,我們對時事,對社會世界局勢是否都很抽離呢?.
我們的信仰,信心,愛心以及生活表現是否能夠不離地呢?要做一個合神心意的屬靈的人,仍然是今時今日的挑戰..
我要做一個不離地的基督徒,去見證榮耀神,所以今天我用《迦勒頓大書》六章一到五節,釋經解說,如何活出一個不離地的屬靈人,我們先簡單的祈禱..
天父安靜我們的心,讓我們生活不是不吃人間煙火,而是入世又出世,如何好好地不離地地做一個土里喜悅的屬靈的人..
我們以下時間奉主耶穌基督的名禱.我們看看一些經文,《迦勒頓大書》六章一到二節..
你們若有人偶然被過犯所成你們屬靈的人,就當用溫柔的心把他挽回過來,又當自己小心,恐怕也被引誘,你們各人的重擔要互相擔當,如此就完全了基督的律法..
人有無有,自己幻以為有,就是自欺了,個人應當審查自己的行為,這樣他所誇的,就專在自己,不在別人了,因為個人必擔當自己的擔子..
這段寶貴的經文提醒我們有六方面要注意,才是真真實實可以做到一個不離地的屬靈人..
第一,能夠用溫柔的心挽回犯過錯的人..
你們看到經文,爭取時間,不讀了..
不知道對犯過錯或得罪你的人,你的態度會是怎樣呢?.
會跟他捏過,不放過,還是會另一個態度呢?.
你是不是很激動,很生氣,就罵他呢?.
還是用一個溫柔沉靜的態度去回應呢?.
哪樣更有效呢?.
曾經有一位傳道人,報道家施暴真,面對一個姐妹..
這個姐妹是一個很挑剔,講是非,詆毀人的人,但是她的性格又很敏感..
她做了這些事後,施暴真以為會向蔣則部施行教會紀律,所以他先發制人..
他向施暴真先下馬威,在情緒高漲,殺氣騰騰地跟施暴真說話..
施暴真卻是很安靜,溫柔的,細聲地回應這位姐妹..
他說目前教會還沒有任何決定會行教會紀律..
施暴真仔細地聆聽這位姐妹的感受和想法,.
為了她的敏感和誤會,施暴真竟然可以向這位姐妹反而表達一個歉意..
請施暴真以耳主的愛去包容,甚至有些不足的地方請施暴真原諒..
原來施暴真用一個溫柔,忍耐和疏導的方法令這位姐妹安靜下來,令她反省..
很多年前我曾經附和一位姐妹,她後來因一些誤會而大聲地指著我來說話..
罵完之後她很爽,我當然不爽,但她仍然不忿..
隔了一段日子,不知道,一人做事一人當,她連師母都生氣,不理睬我們..
我們跟她打招呼,想跟她聊天,她當我們透明,不聽不看,不理不睬..
幾次都令我們難受很難堪..
但我的領受是,越對這些人,我們更要加倍有愛心和忍耐..
結果在大半年時間,我學習了一些寶貴的功夫..
仍然用愛和溫柔和忍耐去挽回..
「姐妹,你是否一個溫柔的人?」.
溫柔在這個原文的意思是,不用一些語言很暴戾,殺氣騰騰的態度,.

$^{41}$或者盛氣凌人的對待,而是很柔和謙卑的語氣和和平的態度去表達..
經文裡面說的過範,其實是有跌倒,偏離,甚至是走歪了聖靈所帶領的路線的意思..
而這裡挽回,就像是駁骨折骨,更引伸有裝備,承傳,保忘的意思..
挽回過範的意思是指使一個跌倒,軟弱,走歪了的人,.
回到正途,保回走應有的路,走回原有的地位和路線..
好比哥林多前書十二章二十三節所提醒的,.
身上肢體我們看為不體面的,就越發體面,不盡美的,越發得著盡美..
甚至二十五節所提醒,免得肢體分門別類,總要肢體彼此相顧..
肢體彼此相顧是一個很重要的道理..
我深信在座的弟兄姊妹,你們一定可以明白,以及靠主做得到..
這個表現正是用溫柔的心,沒有因為持愛,忍耐,而不是激憤,不滿,怨恨,甚至對立的態度..
對一些真的有軟弱,得失理的人,有過範的人,求主幫助我們應該怎樣做,.
這樣才可以做到一個不離地的屬靈人..
第二,能警醒,自己小心,恐怕也被引誘..
有本著識書就是這樣提醒,強調,因為我們都有犯罪的傾向,可能有一天也需要別人來憐憫的..
有一項調查顯示今時今日,甚至多年來,美國的福音信仰和信徒比例,.
是從1900年總人口42.2\%降到2005年14.7\%,是逐年下降的.近年也有下降的趨勢..
美國社會正處於信仰的危機,不單止是這樣,美國的一些宗派,或者因為教會的問題,.
或者分裂,甚至有些教睦以及領袖的醜聞,社會上也有非議,大大影響了社會形象和時空..
這是值得我們每一個基督徒去守望和代禱的事..
美國教會的牧者,其實很多人都以為牧者個個很堅強很淑齡,.
其實正如經文提醒,真的要警醒,要小心,恐怕也會被引誘,誘軟弱..
其實有些令人很擔憂的現象和統計資料,令人不得不為牧者禱告和守望..
我舉幾項其中的資料,第一,美國全國每個月有1500位牧師,.
因為道德問題,或者因為工作過勞,分裂,或者教會內部的不和,而離開他們的崗位..
第二,美國全國每年雖然增加4000間教會,但同時有7000間教會關門..
第三,80\%的牧師和84\%的師母對事奉感到乏力失望..
第四,70\%的牧師經常和抑鬱交戰..
不過以上的資料數字是好幾年前的,有待繼續研究..
主要是指美國一般的西人教會,.
但美國的華人教會或少數族裔教會,未有正式的統計資料調查..
你找到的就告訴我們..
不過如果看這些數字,這些情況,當然會喚起我們每一個人要好好為教會為教牧祈禱..
有幾個令人發人深省的問題,可以幫助我們思考,值得留意..
當我們為生活奔波時,生命在哪裡失落呢?.
當我們追尋知識時,智慧在哪裡失落呢?.
當我們尋找資訊時,知識在哪裡失落呢?.
人在人生路或信仰路途上,不時很容易失落,迷失..
經歷一些事件更令人迷失..
這就是Bonnie真誠的一些剖白,大家都可以感受到..

$^{81}$但更重要的是,這個世界上有很多邪情,私慾和世界的惡者,有惑,迷惑,很多的人..
如何防止自己被引誘,如何可以小心警醒呢?.
我相信唯有你和我時時刻刻同神有一個保持緊密的關係,有警醒的心..
這樣你就可以做得到..
曾經有一個家庭主婦,她說:.
我在洗碗時,我的心對神說,願我的心不會被這些油脂所蒙蔽,能夠清潔乾淨..
當我在洗衣機洗衣服時,她又感覺和神對話,祈禱說:願我的心內的污穢被主潔淨..
當她拿著掃帚掃地時,她在心裡對主說:願我的心沒有污穢,讓我除去不義和我在神眼中看為垃圾的事..
你說這個姐妹傻不傻呢?.
其實她赤誠警醒靠著的心,我相信主必定願立..
另一位姐妹面對一些排山倒海的工作,因為除了要管家務外,她在外面也要工作..
還有一些子女的教養問題,但她仍然這樣說:.
無論我做什麼,都要好像是為神而做..
神啊,求你幫助我做世上的事,雖然人體是世俗的事,也要我做得非常神聖..

$^{1}$在某一夜,我竟然會做出這樣的決定.
就是向神投降.
而且打開了道門.
和耶穌和我一起去見祂們.

祂們的聖骸是一顆聖骸,是一顆聖骸.

我的心.
想想,基督教信仰真是不可思議.

而他搬進來住的那天.

$^{1}$.
提摩太前書第四章第二節,這裡又提到良心,說到一些全假道的人,他們是假冒的,保羅說這等人的良心如同被熱鐵下灌尿一般,意思是說他們有一個意象,我們的良心好像那種,你試過有些傷口,戒損了之後,.
然後你去撓它,撓著撓著,它又流血,又再損,然後它又再戒,你又再撓它的時候,它就會變成疤痕,有疤痕的地方,或者你身上也有不少,你的感覺度就會漸漸降低,.
保羅說如果我們今天在一個不利的環境裡面,我們第一件事就是需要去取回我們生命裡面的良心,一個good conscience,讓上主洗滌了我們之後,我們的良心我們的conscious再一次活躍上來,.
並且主的恩格外豐富,使我在基督耶穌裡面有信心和愛心..
第十五節,基督耶穌降世,為要拯救罪人,這話是可信的,是十分可佩服的,在罪人中可視為罪魁,而我蒙了憐憫,是因為耶穌基督要在我這罪魁身上,顯明他一切的忍耐,給後來信他得永生的人作榜樣,但願尊貴榮耀,貴給那不能扭壞,不能按鍵永世的君王,獨一的上帝,直到永遠完,阿們..
看了這段聖經,你有什麼感覺呢?.
一個很有經驗的牧者,他是第一代的神學家,你想想,保羅寫的東西,今天還有人在研究,他是一個頗好漢學問的人,一個頗有見處的人,他居然寫給他的徒弟講什麼呢?.
他的口氣,你留意,是沒有自大自滿的口氣,完全沒有一丁點說我已經上了岸,我是很有經驗的牧者,你要聽我說..
他說什麼呢?他說他今天,他的雙腳還站不在上帝的恩典裡面,他是罪人裡面的罪人..
我們聽到這些醜聞的時候,我們會很失望,原因有時候是這樣的,牧職這件事是神聖的,職位的職位,牧職,我們叫神職人員,是很神聖的,那個職位是很神聖的..
但我想告訴你,那個職位裡面事奉的人,就不是神聖的,你明白嗎?那個職位是神聖的,但那個在職位裡面事奉的人,絕對不是神聖的..
牧師,牧者,他不是神聖的,傳道人,長執,他們不是,聽清楚,他們不是90\%的罪人,他們也不是99\%的罪人,他們是100\%的罪人,任何人,包括我在內,男與女,我們都是百分之百的罪人..
所以不要將牧者,雖然他在聖堂裡面,他去事奉,他接受了一個呼召去那裡事奉,就把他推到神位,我們有時候不知不覺也會的,因為一起祈禱,誰去祈禱?當然是找牧師祈禱,牧師祈禱比較靈,不是的,我們祈禱是奉耶穌的名,.
不是奉牧者的名,無論你多麼尊敬他也好,你對他一般般也好,牧者不是神聖的,但牧職是神聖的,我們應該要尊重..
所以,很多時候聽到一些性騷擾,性失德的問題,我們經常都會問,為什麼會發生這樣的事情?有什麼因素?我相信有很多因素,Stanley Grant 也在這裡講了很多很多的因素,但最重要的因素是什麼?.
就是我們每個人都是百分之一百的罪人,保羅說我是罪人之中的罪魁,他只不過是一個蒙恩基督教的罪人,到他有見樹的時候,保羅說我仍然是一個罪魁,.
我不是以名目去自居,不是一個有名的人,明星,我們叫做celebrity pastor,來自居,只不過是一個蒙恩基督教的罪人..
所以,有聽到這些消息的時候,我們會感到很失望,不過同樣,這是一個現實,罪人之中,我是一個罪魁..
如果連保羅也這樣說,今天有誰可以誇獎自己有多厲害?.
在過去幾個月裡面,我們講到這個教會,雖然有些處理不當,但有一樣東西我覺得可以肯定和可以欣賞,.
是什麼呢?起碼最後肯認錯,全體的領導甚至願意承擔然後下台,這個真的很難做的,.
勇敢面對自己的失敗,成功的時候我們會拍掌,但面對失敗的時候,這真正是一個試煉,願意謙卑,讓外界其他的第三者介入處理這個問題..
這個可以值得欣賞,雖然很痛苦,但我相信這是一個教會的新開始,願意下台,承擔責任..
香港教會更新協會的一個牧師胡志偉說到這件事的時候,.
他說如果換上是華人的堂會,大可能都是死不認錯,死撐,結果同性留下,不同意的可以離開,.
這個傾向就是要保守自己的權力,保守自己的聖餘,而不是保守上帝的聖餘..
在教會裡面,我們成功的時候我們會學習,但其實失敗的時候我們都應該學習..
你聽到一些牧師跌倒的時候,聽到一些基督徒失見證的時候,你的反應可能會很不同,可能你會覺得這整件事很傻,你可能會覺得這個信仰是白痴的..
但請你不要忘記,請你不要忘記有幾樣東西,請你不要將你的信仰放在一個人,或者一個制度身上..
無論那個制度外表有多美麗,無論那個人外表有多值得你去欣賞,你的信仰,你的信心不是放在人或制度上,你的信心是放在上帝的信仰..
基督耶穌降世,為要拯救罪人,這話是可信,是十分可佩服..
這句話是初期教會認信的confession,其中一個,一個宣言,trustworthy saying,是要我們full acceptance,就是將我們的信仰,我們的信心放在救我們的主..
不是某某的人,或者某某的機構制度,某某的名字,而是放在上帝的名字上..
所以你有什麼反應都好,請你放正你自己的信仰,放在上帝的信仰..
第二,請你都小心,我們不要覺得我們自己是隔岸觀火..
保羅在另一封書信說,所謂自以為站得穩的,需要謹慎,免得跌倒..
我們見到別人跌倒,我們自然會覺得,咦,我站得很穩..
保羅在這裡警惕我們,不要自告,因為我們都是百分之一百罪的,我們不能夠跟失德的人說,咦,我比你好..
請你小心,我們每一個自以為站得穩的人要謹慎,免得跌倒..

$^{41}$第三,我想告訴你,有很多人仍然是很努力的,很有誠信的,去服侍教會的..
請你不要忘記,有很多這樣的人..
新聞裡面特別強調某幾單,這些失德的問題..
但是我想告訴你,有很多人正在努力的,在建立教會,很有誠信..
願意奉上來服侍我們的上帝..
但是不是因為我們厲害,不是因為人跌倒,而是神的福音是可信的..
保羅也是一樣,保羅沒有說,咦,我繼續去做,我繼續去事奉,繼續去信..
是因為我沒有跌倒過,他說什麼呢?.

$^{1}$主席.
今日的主要崇拜,現在剩下大約二十多分鐘,所以我會很簡單地提出三件事,特別是針對做核心領袖的,或者預備選核心領袖的,甚至每一個基督徒都應該要著意的三件事..
我選的經文是希伯來書一章五到十一節,我們一起讀一讀..
弟兄讀單數,姊妹讀雙數..
所有的天使,神從來對那一個說,你是我的兒子,我今日生你,又指著哪一個說,我要作他的父,他要作我的子..
(主席再讀).
弟兄,論到使者有說,神以風為使者,以火焰為伏翼.姊妹..
(主席再讀).
弟兄,你喜愛公義,恨惡所以神,就是神,用喜內柔告你,勝過告你的同伴..
(主席再讀).
弟兄,天地要長存,你卻要長存,天地都要仗衣服,漸漸夠了..
(主席再讀).
我們低頭有個簡單的劇主,但你仍是誰顧我們每一個的人.主,你提醒我們在你面前的,如何更多依靠你,更多榮耀你,更多經歷神你自己的恩典..
我們今日聽道的時間雖短,但求你幫助我們有一個謙卑,信服和願意受教的心..
祈禱奉主耶穌基督的名,阿們..
我提出三件要事,第一件就是要尊敬主..
在第五到第六節,你會見到有關的經文..
現代中文,日本語都最清楚,不過時間關係不講..
我們可以看到,天使雖然被稱為神的眾子,但父神唯獨對耶穌基督說:你是我的兒子,我今日生你..
我們見到耶穌基督的位格和神聖,他與父神同樣的尊貴,是超過天使等級的..
我們又看到天使都要拜他,敬畏他..
在第六節提到長子,你會見到,史圖保羅用手生的,源始的,再許多弟兄中作長子來形容耶穌基督..
一切信耶穌的人都得到神兒子的名份,是嗎?.
耶穌基督不單是神的獨生子,更成為長子,成為一切相信耶穌救贖的人的手生,源始或長子..
而這位父神的長子,愛子,連天上所有的使者,天使都要敬他,拜他..
所以耶穌基督的超越性和獨特性,是有尊貴的得勝者..
所以第六節提到,第七節,連風和火焰都要聽他的話..
弟兄姊妹,我們又檢視一下,這位天上的父神,直接被稱為神的愛子..
他連萬有的父,都看重他..
特別欽點他的耶穌基督,我們抱著什麼態度對他呢?.
連上帝所有的天使都要拜他,尊貴他,榮耀他..
但是相對來說,今時今日我們對耶穌的表現是怎樣呢?.
何時我們當主耶穌是主呢?.
在我們日常生活當中,我們有沒有真的尊崇主,耶穌是主呢?.
我們拜他,敬他,那種心態表現又是怎樣呢?.
我們常說要用心靈誠實來拜他,敬畏他..
但是在日常生活中,甚至在事奉中,我們敬畏,尊主為大的程度又是怎樣呢?.
這正是我們值得再想一想..
特別我們說我們要作教會的核心領袖,.
我們將要選出事奉主的人,.

$^{41}$甚至你說我自己只是一個很平凡的平信徒,.
但是這裡提醒我們,敬畏主,敬虔的去愛神,.
是一個屬靈生命很基本的態度和心智..
我們一起彼此面對..
曾經有一個牧師面對一個教友,.
被他所說和表現的東西搞得啼笑皆非..
這位教友以前是一個好賭的人,是一個賭徒,.
日夜沉迷賭博,但後來他信了耶穌,.
他說我信了耶穌,我要變,我要尊敬主,我要放棄賭博了..
但是他不斷說,他不是很徹底,.
他仍然留地步給魔鬼,反而狡詐的對牧師說,.
這副啤牌跟了我很多年,我一定要保留它,.
其實這副啤牌可以見到神的恩典,.
當我見到Ace的時候,我記起神是最大,全能獨一的真神,.
二字牌的時候,我想到神起初做亞當,夏娃,建立二人世界,.
三牌令我想起給了我三次不認主,我要更加警醒,.
四牌使徒保羅念同去羅馬宣教的路程,.
有大大話話四次,提起我要將福音遍傳耶路撒冷,.
猶大傳遞撒瑪利亞直到地極,我要做一個傳福音的使者,為主作見證..
五牌,令我想起利未記,那五種制字,他很厲害,.
哪五種制字?利未記的五種制字,.
凡制,數制,平安制,贖罪制,贖軒制,很多人都不懂,.
但他講到,這五種制字提醒我要聖潔的過日子,.
啤牌的J,思洗藥巷是主耶穌的開路先鋒,.
Queen,想起瑪利亞的信服,King,想起萬王之王,萬主之主,和平之君,.
啤牌第一隻是Ace,耶穌是首先的,最後一隻是King,耶穌是末後的,.
心,Heart,提醒我要愛人,用心,.
愧是,好像一把銼,一個鏟,提醒我為主努力作功,.
階磚是鑽石,提醒我的信心要像鑽石一樣堅硬,.
他解釋得好像是頭頭是道,這位完全未解道的教友,.
滔滔不絕發表偉論,似是而非,滿口屬靈的名詞,.
其實是將聽過的道理,用私心,私意,仍然順著自己好賭的情慾,.
美化甚至堂然王之的論調表達出來,.
根本與蒙召的因未有相稱,.
其實當主耶穌仍然是無道,生命未徹底改變,.
不是真正的敬主,愛主的人,.
他的屬靈表現是這樣的貨色,.
但我們回想一下自己,今時今日,我何嘗不是這樣呢?.
在神面前好像知很多事,講得很堂皇,.
不知是怎樣一回事呢?.

$^{81}$弟兄姊妹,你在我日常生活中,是否真真實實的尊崇主,敬畏主呢?.
這實在是我們需要求主幫助我們..
第二件事,我們看第八,第九節,就是要彰顯主..
「夫臣的兒子耶穌基督,他的寶座是世世長存,.
他的國權是正直,守公義,恨邪惡,賜予喜樂,.
每一位信徒,每一位作主門徒的人.」.
我們生命和生活當然是要彰顯主,要榮耀神,見證基督,.
但實際情況是否這樣呢?.
我們特別信了主若干年的人,.
我們似乎被一種基督教文化或氣氛所感染,.
很順理成章地表達一些東西,但實際上裡面的餡是如何呢?.
英國著名牧師默遜死後,.
有人在書桌的抽屜裡找到一封信,.
他生前沒有提及,有人看了這封信,.
原來寫這封信的人是因為聽過牧師默遜的講道而信了耶穌..
他在信裡對牧師說:.
「我最初對你所傳的道理有興趣,不是因為你所講的道,.
而是因為你講道時面上那種聖潔的美麗和喜樂的光彩,.
吸引我,要知道你所傳講的,究竟這位耶穌是怎樣的..
請展回真是,你嘴上這樣說,.
但你的生命和生活的行動是更加實際,更有影響力,.
道言之言不變之變比講話更有力..
本身生命的外顯和感染力,程度是怎樣,.
其實是反映你裡面的生命的質素和活力是怎樣的..
今日我們每一位被提醒要好好培養我們裡面的屬靈質素和生命是怎樣的..
請問你花了多少時間好好靈修讀經,好好去到神的面前呢?.
不要說每一天,每個星期,計算總數是多少,當然不是用量來計算,.
而是質素是怎樣的呢?.
有沒有好好地經歷在神那裡支取到力量,.
以至外面流露出來基督的那種氣香,能夠令人羨慕呢?.
按經文所講的,這裡提及幾個質素,包括有正直公平,.
包括有喜愛公義,恨惡罪惡,包括有喜樂的表演等等..
究竟我們能夠彰顯這幾方面有多少呢?.
這個不同,我們真的需要靠主流露基督的美事..
英國大文豪查理士·狄更斯和當時一位很出名的朋友戴格里發生爭執,.
大家不太妥當,在1863年的聖誕節,他們剛剛在倫敦這個地方碰頭,.
大家碰到面,視若陌路人,雙方不理睬,.
但戴格里覺得良心不安,轉身,主動走向狄更斯,.
他舉起了雙手,表示不能忍受我們之間的隔膜,不能忍受疏離的關係..
狄更斯深受感動,於是大家對話聊天,前言盡釋,和好如初..

$^{121}$沒多久之後,戴格里突然離世..
一段日子之後,有人見到狄更斯站在戴格里的墓前,.
我相信他心裡一定很釋然,問心無愧,再無遺憾,.
因為他們曾經不和,有爭執,有心病,.
但在戴格里死前幾日,狄更斯終於和他握手言和,.
已經拆毀了雙方之間彼此的嚴規..
弟兄姊妹,主耶穌基督,因著祂的愛,.
因著祂自己的恩典,已經拆毀,接受了我們..
我們和神之間的牆已經拆毀,直的關係沒問題,.
但橫的關係,我們和人與人之間的關係,那種嚴規有沒有拆毀呢?.
這經文告訴我們,神喜愛公義,恨惡罪惡,.
所以耶穌是和平之君,.
祂來到這個世間,要拆毀人與人之間的厚厚的牆..
我不知道你和某些人,或者弟兄姊妹,或者你的家人,.
或者親人,有沒有一些厚厚的牆隔著?.
有些人和某些親人,可以不說話,甚至同一屋簷下,.
我真的見過聽過這些例子,其實很痛苦,但仍然當沒有回事..

但我們知道,當我們讓基督掌權的時候,.

你對某些人的不滿,不和,或者對弟兄姊妹,有一些不接受,不相往來,.
如果是同一個教會,同一個團契,我們需要靠主去對付,去處理..
特別作為一個教會的領袖,預備作主聖公的人,.
他必須與人和善相親,他能夠謙卑愛人,他不能夠冷漠,很孤傲..
他不是這樣才容易與人相處,和配搭,同工..
求主幫助我們,藉著耶穌的大能大力,幫助我們,.
深信神今天願助著為王,加我們力量,賜我們智慧..
神必定祝福一些按他心意行事為人的人..
第三,我們看看第十到十二節,提出要注意的要事,就是要依靠主..
三一真實,包括耶穌基督,去創天造地,創造萬物,.
萬物都會改變,會消逝,天地都會捲起來..
但主耶穌是常存的,永不改變的,主的年歲是無窮盡的,永在不變..
大能的主甚至能夠改變天地和環境,.
但我們經常聽過,或經歷過,主的意念不同人的意念,主的道路非同人的道路,.
天怎樣高過地,照樣主的道路高過人的道路,主的意念也高過人的意念..
《耳塞書》55章8-9提醒我們,我們的主是永恆的主,不服在時間以下,.
他是昭然永存,無始無終,主處理的事件不會依附我們的時間表,.
因為他是萬有的主,掌管一切的神,時間和一切都在神的掌握下,.
命立就立,命成就就成就,沒有什麼可以攔阻或左右他的指引和安排..

$^{161}$所以弟兄姊妹,我們要明白,人有時並非全部都能幹,人始終有限,.
我們與這位無限奇畏的神相比之下,我們只是滄海的一叔,.
我們的一知半解以不知為知,我們有時用直覺,用自己的想法,自以為是,其實會變得很無端..
我們自以為認識很多東西,其實會留於偏差,我們自以為聰明,.
這些辦法以為行,其實可能行不通..
當行不通的時候,我們會誤解神,你不聽我祈禱,我們會埋怨神,不照我的方法辦事,.
神啊,你真是無能,你也不是這樣的,你不理我,你也不肯照應我..
或者你曾聽過一個故事,爸爸帶女兒去一個地方玩具店買洋娃娃,.
進去店舖,小女孩一見到洋娃娃,在面前說:我要這個..
其實爸爸心目中有一個更好,更大,更美的送給她..
爸爸隨手拿走女兒想要的次好的洋娃娃,女兒當場發了冷顫,.
抱著不放,大哭大讓,沒辦法,唯有按她的心意,給她一個次好的..
那個更好的,更美的,因為這個女兒自以為是,自恃自主,.
以有限的短小的眼光和思想,拒絕那個更上好的,更美好的福分,結果走寶..
同樣我們基督徒也是,有時我們以為一些事是應該這樣,是很好的,但神有更好的..
我們不記得經文,羅馬書八章三十二節說:.
「不愛惜自己的兒子,也為我們眾人寫明:喜不也把萬物和他人一同白白賜給我們.」.
神會將最好的給我們,特別今天我們面對一些處境,.
我們想都不明白為何神會讓這些事情發生,但神總有最美善的旨意,可能是一個試煉,.
可能經歷了這些的時候,我們會認識神更多,自己和神的關係會進深..
有時我們的信心和眼光真的太短小,主耶穌基督今天提醒我們,.
祂今天仍然是永不改變的主,祂今天仍然坐著為王的,.
掌管一切包括你人生大小的事,你的疾病,你的健康,你的經濟,你的家庭,你的兒女,子孫,.
你信不信神會將最好的給你呢?為了我們更多的依靠主,你會經歷更多..
最近我和師母回香港,有機會見到一個姐妹,她在香港某大學做教授,.
她見證神的信實和奇妙,大家都知道,在大學,很多大學都要爭表現,.
現在香港更標榜要創新科研發展,要爭取政府的金錢資助,.
這個姐妹又要教學,又要研究,又要提交提案,壓力大到她吃不消,結果她病了..
偏偏病了的那段日子,她要安排見政府的資助評審委員會,要提出她的計劃方案..
她說當時她完全在病裡面,不是狀態,但卻將這件事切切的交給神,.
她很高的祈禱依靠主,神是掌管她當時的論述和講話的應對,.
很稀奇,過了一段日子,她聽聞局方決定全面資助她的計劃,.
她自己當時覺得自己說得不好,或者表達得很差,但因為她依靠神,.
她就把軟弱當成剛強,放一些不可能的為神奇..
姐妹很感恩,是聖靈帶領她的解說和決策的人的決議,.
一切都是因為她依靠主而得的成果..
真的弟兄姊妹,今天我們要學習更多的依靠主,.
我們事奉神的人,我們更需要很好的依靠主..
在北極附近有一個海峽,見到一堆一堆巨大的浮冰,.
最大的浮冰有三四百尺高,當時吹著很強的南風,.

$^{201}$但很奇怪,浮冰卻是冒著大浪的衝擊,逆風向南飄浮,而不是向北飄浮..
原來冰山露出的水面只佔全體的體積百分之一,.
然後還有百分之七在下面,當時的水流是向南流,.
雖然海面上吹著很大的強風,但冰山的流向主要是受水流的影響,.
冰山大部分在水的下面,再大的風都不能改變冰山的流向..
同樣道理,弟兄姊妹,當我們的信心紮根在主耶穌基督那裡,.
上面吹著很強大的風,.
怎樣吹襲,怎樣打擊,甚至狂風巨浪,.

$^{1}$Well, before we go into God's Word, let me pray for us..
Father, it is your Word we are going to read and study..
So we trust you will give us your Word and it will return to you having accomplished.
your will and your purposes..
Be glorified as your Word is preached and proclaimed..
We pray in Jesus' name..
Amen..
So we are in 2 Timothy chapter 4, verse 6-3..
So 2 Timothy is believed to be one of the last letters that Paul wrote..
And it was written to his son and his apprentice, his disciple, Timothy..
So you know, it's been said that when people are at the edge of death, that their life.
flashes before their eyes..
So what do you imagine are the final thoughts you're going to have when you come to that.
day?.
Will you remember a life that has lived well?.
Maybe you'll have dreams that you remember, dreams that have been forgotten, plans that.
are not fulfilled..
Perhaps you'll have no regrets at all..
Or maybe you'll have many regrets..
And then what about what's on the other side of death?.
Do you think about what will be waiting for you?.
The Apostle Paul knows that he is about to face the end of his life..
So he tells Timothy these final words..
And it's from his second letter in chapter 4, verse 6..
And he says, "I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time has come.
for my departure..
I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith..
Now there is in store for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous.
judge, will award to me on that day..
And not only to me, but also to all who have longed for His appearance.".
So Paul says, "I am already being poured out like a drink offering.".
And I believe he is talking about a drink offering, referencing a drink offering that.
is talked about in the Old Testament..
And this drink offering involves wine being poured on a hot altar..
So when the alcohol and the sugars burn up, there's this wonderful smell in the air..
An offering that goes to God..
And the idea is that God would smell this wonderful smell, and he would be worshipped..
So yes, Paul is talking about that he is going to die soon..
Kind of like pouring out a cup and saying, "It's over.".
But he's also referring to, "My life is being poured out like worship to God.".

$^{41}$So he's not just saying, "My life is over, I'm done.".
But he's saying, "Look, my life is worship to God.".
And Paul talks and uses language that we would hear in athletics, in sports, and he's.
done this in other places too, but he does it here..
So he says, "I have fought the good fight like a boxer.".
I have finished the race like a runner..
And then he makes it clear, he's not just talking about physical activity, and he says,.
"I have kept the faith.".
In other words, Paul is saying, "Look, my life is filled with so much evidence that.
my life was lived for Jesus.".
This life is a wonderful scent to God..
But I ask, what about me?.
What about you?.
Is your life, is my life so filled with proof that we have lived it well for Jesus?.
That you and me, we could both say confidently, "Look, my life has been lived for worship.
of God.".
God would smell the scent of my life and be, "Ah, please.".
Think about what would people who know you say about your life?.
How about a coworker, or a neighbor, or a friend?.
Maybe a family member..
Would they say, "Are you a Christian?".
What if they came and surprised you, they visited you at this church, didn't know you.
go to church here, and they find you and they say, "Wow, you're a Christian?".
Would they say, "You know, I thought you might be because of the way you act.".
I thought there was something different about you because the way you are always so kind.
to me and other people..
I thought maybe you were a follower of Jesus because the way you live, it reminds me of.
Jesus..
Or would somebody find you at church and say, "What?.
You're a Christian?".
The way you're always complaining about the boss at work..
How mean you are to the neighbors..
Your language, the way you curse all the time and say evil words..
I had no idea you were a Christian..
What would people say of us?.
See our lives, our speech, our attitude, our behaviors, these can tell people that something.
has happened to you..
When Jesus has taken over our lives, people might ask, "What's going on?".
And what an opportunity to tell them, "It's because of Jesus.".
Let me tell you about Jesus..

$^{81}$He's loved me..
He's changed me..
He's made me new..
I hope that our lives would invite people to ask..
Now let's not forget as we look at this passage that Paul knows that he's going to die too..
He says, "The time of my departure has come.".
And he's not just going to a new city..
He's leaving this world and he will be in the presence of God..
But Paul is not worrying about it..
He's not fearful of it..
I think he's excited about it..
That Paul sees this as a release..
He's being untied..
From this body of death..

that I am.".
This is one of the holiest men in the world..
And he says, "What a wretched man that I am.".
He says, "Who is going to save me from this body of death?".
And what does he say?.
"Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord because Jesus has delivered me from this.
body of death.".
So most of us know somebody who seems to be trapped in their body..
Maybe they're paralyzed or handicapped in some way..
Maybe they have some kind of physical weakness..

have eternal life..
But then one day he met Jesus..

He had lived such a perfect life that in Philippians, another letter he writes, he says, "If anyone.
else thinks he has reason to put confidence in the flesh," meaning the things he has done.
with his body, he says, "I have more confidence.".
And basically he says, "I have obeyed all the laws..
I come from the right kind of family..
And I'm from the right nation..
And the way I live has been with great passion for God.".
So passionate I even persecuted his church..

What does he say?.
For Jesus, all of this is loss..
To all of Paul's Jewish peers, they would have said, "Oh, I wish I had his life..

But Paul continues and says, "Whatever was my profit, I now consider loss because of.
Jesus.".
And then he says, "What is more, I consider everything loss compared to the surpassing.
knowledge of knowing Christ Jesus, my Lord.".
He says, "I consider it all rubbish, garbage, junk, worthless compared to knowing Jesus.".

$^{161}$Wow..
Can you say that?.
That compared to knowing Jesus, everything else is just garbage?.
That without Jesus, everything is meaningless?.

the power of his resurrection and the fellowship of sharing in his sufferings.".
Do you get that?.

He says, "I even want to share in his suffering..
Jesus is so valuable..
I even want to know what it feels like to suffer like him.".
And then even becoming like him in his death so that he could have the resurrection..
I mean this sounds like crazy talk, doesn't it?.

Paul gave up everything because he saw that Jesus was such a treasure..
Everything else was junk..
You see Paul met Jesus on the road to Damascus and his life was changed forever..

That's when his fight began..
And Paul says, "I have fought the good fight.".

It is believed that in ancient Rome and in ancient Greece that the athletes would make.
a promise..
They would devote their race or their performance to their God..
So if it was Zeus, that is their God, they would say, "For Zeus, I will run this race.
and I will win.".
And today we see this tradition carried out in the Olympics..

What did they do?.

I have kept the faith.".
So having completed what he was charged to do, Paul reveals his confidence..
So look at 2 Timothy chapter 4, verse 8..
He says, "Now there is in store for me the crown of righteousness which the Lord, the.

$^{201}$righteous judge, will award me on that day, and not only to me but also to all who have.

the line..

to cross the finish line..

$^{1}$今天不說小敏的故事了,因為最精彩的都說完了.今天和你們說Ben的故事.Ben是香港人,50歲..
不過回頭看,1990年的時候,22歲,他來到美國,去了這裡最有名的芝加哥大學讀MBA..
到了25歲,他畢業了.因為他太厲害了,頭腦太靈活了,所以很快就被有名的公司聘用了..
一直都做得非常好,做金融.說一下他1998年,30到40歲這段期間,他事業非常有成,賺了很多錢..
不過我還沒說他的樣子,類似這些樣子.不過這個太年輕了,如果Ben50歲的話,可能像這個..
真的這麼帥,所以他讀書的時候就有很多女生追求他..
他也拍拍手,30歲在一個生日派對看到一位很漂亮的女生,是香港來的,也是讀MBA的..
所以一見鍾情就約會了.拍了半年拖,一晚Ben請女朋友去一家很高檔的意大利餐廳,很浪漫的意大利餐廳吃飯..
叫了一瓶很漂亮的紅酒,喝一喝,有侍應推著一大車玫瑰花來到這張桌子..
有幾個穿著小提琴的,拉著小提琴的,大家知道為什麼了..
然後Ben在西裝拿出一個盒子,一打開就發光了,大家知道是什麼了..
然後就跪在地上,女朋友就……大家都知道接下來會怎樣了..
所以五年之間Ben結婚,生了一個小孩,一對雙胞胎,很可愛,還有一個兒子,三個..
所以一家五口富裕家庭,外人看起來很羨慕,但也有暗湧的..
因為Ben應酬很多,所以子女經常見不到他..
太太睡著睡著,半夜也不見他在身邊..
再說Ben到了45歲,子女開始變青年了,大家都知道了,沒什麼可以說的了..
太太經常說話,但Ben又不想聽..
說不說也好,反正Ben生活很豐富,因為他雄心壯志..
當時他公司想請他做CEO,但他賺錢不夠,所以他自己出來做生意,做物流,Logistics..
在芝加哥的單攤旁邊買了一間舊舊的辦公室,買了一棟來做辦公室..
大家也知道2013年,早五年左右,美國經濟也不是很好..
但他做物流就好了,因為中國經濟開放,所以打通中國的那條線,Ben真的有很多東西賺..
他生意做得非常好,有幾十個手下.再過兩年,特朗普上台後,還將很多規矩減少了,所以他的生意更加好..
所以真的多到做不完..
他想想,要搬辦公室了,不過不好了,芝加哥的地點這麼好,不如把舊的辦公室拆掉,建一個新的..
再請多些人,所以在一兩年之間,又做了這件事..
而且新的辦公室建了之後,生意非常好,新公司建起來了..
BEN還拿了很多錢投資房子,所以錢真的財源滾來滾去,擋也擋不住..
今年八月,適逢Ben五十歲,所以他就舉辦了一個慶祝會..
請很多人恭喜他,恭喜之餘,Ben很開心,他自己就閃到露台,左手一個雪茄,右手一個布蘭地,放下摸摸自己的肚腩..
自言自語說,我真的挺令人羨慕的,一個美麗的老婆,一對可愛的雙胞胎,一個可愛的兒子,生意投資順利,財源滾來滾去,.
生意不如交給手下,我不用做,不如天天吃盡山珍海味,每個月環遊世界,哈哈哈哈,很厲害..
誰知道,突然間Ben的心狀狀變得很痛,人生什麼都能預料,但這一切他是預料不到的,所以突然間就這樣了..
大家知道了吧?大家睜大眼睛看著我,這個故事是不是真的?.
不過我還沒回答你之前,我想問你,你聽這個故事的時候,你想想聖經裡面耶穌說過什麼比喻最像這個故事呢?.
司見說的,財主的比喻,在路加福音第十二章,財主的比喻,不如我們看看,我們一起讀吧..
字很小,看到就讀吧..
有一個財主田產豐盛,自己心裡思想說,我的出產沒有地方收藏,怎麼辦呢?.
又說,我要怎樣辦?要把我的創房拆了,令它更大的,在那裡好收藏我一切的糧食和財物,然後對我的靈魂說,.

$^{41}$靈魂啊,你有很多藏的積存,可作多年的費用,只管安安逸逸地吃喝快樂吧..
神對他說,無知的人啊,今夜必要你的靈魂,你所預備的要歸誰呢?.
真的跟Ben的故事有點像,如果我們看這個財主的話,我們可以用四句話來說他..
第一,他頭腦很靈活,財產多到不夠放置,他拆了再建一個,不用搬,但又可以建一個大的創房,擺放新的財寶,新的收成,這是財主的比喻..
他成功富有,這裡說得很清楚..
第三,他知滿自得,我們看得很清楚,當他很有錢的時候,他對自己的靈魂說,你有很多積存,可作多年的費用,只管安安逸逸地吃喝快樂吧..
知滿自得..
最後一個就是,一鳴護符..
Ben的故事不過是現代家園家造版的財主的故事,純屬虛構,但內容並非憑空道讚,當然作者就是我..
財主的故事,如果你們讀英文,你們就記得是甚麼?.
Parable of Rich Fool,是愚蠢財主的故事..
這個愚蠢財主是神對有錢人的境界,究竟這個財主的比喻是神對有錢人的境界呢?.
所以我們這些不是財主的,可以在旁邊沾沾自喜地看show..
究竟財主的比喻是不是真的有錢人的問題呢?.
要回答這個問題,我們要細心偵查一下這段聖經的內容,有沒有給我們答案..
一開始我們看到財主說,我的出產,我要這樣做,我的倉房,好收藏,我的一切,你覺得這個人怎樣?.
很自大,他心目中有自己這個成功的人,但完全沒有半點感恩的心..
可以說在這個人的人生字典裡面是沒有神的..
他有自己,我的出產,我要這樣做,我的倉房,好收藏,我的一切..
再看下去,他自滿自得的時候,他對自己的靈魂說,你有很多的積藏,可以作多年的費用,只管安安逸逸,吃喝快樂..
這個人不單覺得什麼都是他自己,我所擁有的是我的,而且他覺得我想怎樣做就怎樣做..
可以說他就是他自己的神,他的結局是怎樣呢?.
我們知道如果神是真的話,不是你說沒有神就沒有神,結局就是神出來了,神對財主說,無知的人啊,今夜我要你的靈魂,你所預備的要歸誰呢?.
我們想像一下,財主慶祝的時候,他一生的財源滾滾,他有很多的慶祝,玩的時候是彩色繽紛的,但是突然間變成一片漆黑..
我們可以想像一下,他的派對的狂歡聲,喝酒碰杯聲,突然間停頓..
當神出來說要收回一切的時候,一切都停頓.財主在這個時候突然間覺悟到,原來我所擁有的不是我的,原來拿走就拿走了,不過太遲了..
說到這裡,耶穌給了一個輕描淡寫的評論,他說,凡為自己積財,在神面前卻不負足的也是這人..
口語化就是說,凡是那些富有而目中無神的人,他的結局就是這樣,一名戶父卻無永恆的福分..
回到剛才的問題,這個財主的比喻是不是只講給有錢人聽的呢?.
如果我們真的要找到答案的話,我們就要像看電影一樣,倒敘一下,看回頭..
我們看兩個倒敘,第一個倒敘就是,耶穌講這個比喻的源由是什麼呢?.
我們看一看,原來在財主的比喻之前有幾句是我們不可以忽視的..
我們看第十三節,眾人當中有一個人對耶穌說,夫子,請你吩咐我的兄長和我分開家業..
這個人來到耶穌面前,耶穌說,你幫我和我的兄長分開家業,我們很難搞定,我們家產都咬得臉紅臉綠,你們幫我們分開家業..
耶穌的反應有兩個,第一個,他說,你這個人,哪一個納我做你段氏的法官,讓你分家業的?.
這句話是什麼意思呢?.
如果我們想,耶穌當時在這個世界上的時候,他很努力很忙碌很盡心地傳講天國的道理,叫罪人悔改,又醫病趕鬼,彰顯天國的榮耀,耶穌正在做這些事情..
而這個弟兄,他好像不是,他好像是明白了,他來到耶穌面前,耶穌很忙碌的時候,他說,耶穌,你幫我分家產..
所以耶穌跟他講了這句話,第二個反應才厲害,耶穌說,於是對眾人說,你們要謹慎自守,免對一切的貪心,因為人的生命不在乎家道豐富..
你聽下去,如果你叫耶穌幫你分家產,耶穌這樣跟你說,我沒空幫你做這件事,然後跟別人說,貪,不要貪,那不就是在說他,好像很狠..

$^{81}$為什麼這個人求耶穌分家產,耶穌不幫他不要緊,還要這樣作弄他,說他貪呢?.
其實我們不知道這個仁兄是不是真的貪,因為聖經沒有說,但是我們知道的就是,耶穌說完貪之後,然後就說這個財主的比喻..

$^{1}$各位早安!我們繼續這個系列叫做逆境前行.上個星期開始我們看一些不是平時我們停修的時候看的聖經,或者我們很少會留意的聖經,看看裡面有什麼神學的教訓,信仰,和生命裡面的一些提醒..
你記得上次我們打開去舊約一本書叫做《利未記》,今天就意猶未盡,我們仍然是在看《利未記》的.有聖經的話請你幫我打開..
去到《利未記》第十一章一節開始..
(1)對摩西和亞倫說:你們曉如以色列人說,在地上一切的酒受中可吃的乃是這些.凡提婚兩婦,杜雀的酒受,你們都可以吃..
但那杜雀或分堤之中不可吃的乃是,駱駝因為杜雀不分堤,就與你們不結證;沙蕃因為杜雀不分堤,就與你們不結證;兔子因為杜雀不分堤,就與你們不結證;豬因為堤分兩反,卻不杜雀,就與你們不結證;.
這些瘦的肉,你們不可吃;死的,你們不可摸,都與你們不結證.水中可吃的乃是這些.凡在水裡,海裡,河裡,有刺,有鱗的,都可以吃.凡在海裡,河裡,並一切水裡游動的活物,無刺無鱗的,你們都當以為可憎..
這些無刺無鱗以為可憎的,你們不可吃他的肉;死的,也當以為可憎.凡水裡無刺無鱗的,你們都當以為可憎.雀鳥當中,你們當以為可憎的,不可吃的乃是:鵰,狗頭鵰,熊頭鵰,妖鷹,小鷹與其類,烏鴉與其類,鴕鳥,夜鷹,魚鷹,鷹與其類..
這裡有17字..
鵰鵰,鵰鵰,貓頭鷹,鴿齒,鶘鵰,貫鵰,鵰鵰與其類,大吟與蝙蝠..
這些經文的內容都是與舊約的神的子民猶太人的食譜有關..
有些食物可以吃,有些不可以吃,有些是潔淨的,可以放進口中,有些是不潔淨的,不可以放進口中..
其實經文的內容提到有三類的活物,在世間當中,有地上的,有水裡面的,也有天空上的活物..
所以你不要理會他列出的那些什麼什麼的,我弄了很久才知道廣東話怎麼說..
地上不可吃的是什麼呢?.
他說找到的那些活物是分體的和加上杜著的,即是反初的,那些你才可以吃..
水裡面的有刺有鱗的,其他就是可憎的不潔的..
天上的飛的,沒有列出可以吃什麼,不過列了一堆不可以吃的,有十幾種..
上次我們提到舊約聖經裡面神學,說到潔淨與不潔淨的時候,很多時候主要說的不是罪與義的問題..
不是說這些狗頭雕有罪,不是moral的問題,也不是說衛生hygiene的問題,也不是說科學的問題..
潔淨與不潔淨是關乎在我們不同的文化,這些經文當然是說到舊約時候文化,他們有不同的category..
我們每一個人,每一個文化都有我們的category,上次我們舉了一個例子,鞋放在哪裡,我們認為它應該belong,屬於哪個地方..
鞋放在地上,我們就不會覺得是dirt來的,但是鞋放在餐桌上,我們就會覺得是污糟的..
或者我們亞洲人,我們進屋的時候,我們要做什麼?.
這是我們的ritual,我們的禮儀,你必須要脫鞋,你不能說我剛剛買的鞋是新的,我可以穿上去到處踩,因為是不屬於裡面的..
這個就是我們文化裡面有的order和disorder,order就是說屬於那裡的東西應該放在那裡,disorder就是說不應該放在那裡的東西放在那裡,放錯了就變成了混沌,類別不對..
所以我們說到潔淨與不潔淨,應該是這樣想,什麼叫做category..
說到食物的category,我們不同的文化有不同的類別所分的,有些屬於食物,有些不屬於食物..
中國的華人,亞洲人其實都是有這樣的觀念的..
我和大家玩個遊戲好不好?快問快答..
我們說到食物的時候,有些什麼是可以吃的,有些什麼是不可以吃的..
白雲鳳爪你覺得可以吃嗎?.
有人認同,對你來說如果你認同的話,就是不潔了..
我太太不吃白雲鳳爪,但是豉汁的鳳爪她也吃,所以白雲鳳爪她就不潔了..
這個是她的category,我再問你,豬紅可以吃嗎?.
有誰覺得可以吃的?.
那些沒有舉手的可能是不吃的,對你來說就是不潔了..
不潔不是因為不衛生,不潔就是不在食物的category裡面..
大腸呢?吃不吃?有人不吃,不吃就覺得你不在那個category,無論放在哪裡都好,你都不會吃的..
但是我想問你,如果炸得很香你吃不吃?都不吃,所以就不是煮法問題,總之大腸炸是不可以吃的..
我沒有照片,免得弄一張照片出來,狗肉呢?.

$^{41}$這些不在我們的category裡面..
或者我說一個水果的時候,你覺得水果是可以吃的嗎?有什麼水果是絕對不可以吃的?.
有誰在這裡不吃榴槤的?死都不吃的..
你學吃呢?有些人學吃就喜歡吃的,會不會?不會吧?永遠都不會?那你就走寶了,水果王..
所以我們每個人都有不同的category,所以這個不是hygiene的問題,而是我們的組織和我們的所謂類別..
如果你問猶太人的食物的話,他們都是這樣的,每一個文化的食譜都有它的傳統,可能是歷世歷代遺留下來的傳統..
華人的文化,當然說到食物的文化,我們很多東西都可以吃的,對於一些白人來說,可能有很多東西對他們來說是厭惡的,可憎的,disgusting或者是unclean..
我記得我讀研究院的時候,我有一個白人的老師,那個教授,他說他小時候有機會去Chinatown,.
他小時候在Chinatown看到有些店鋪有一個水缸,他看到魚在游來游去,他覺得那個是一個寵物店,.
誰知道進去的時候發現他罵那些魚,然後就砍了它,然後就賣給別人,他覺得很disgusting,他覺得很噁心,.
他說為什麼要這樣對待魚,這個是他的文化和我們的文化的差異.猶太人都是一樣,或者這些食物的文化都是基於一些生物的特性,.
有些可能是可憎的食物,一些可能是雜食性的食物,鷹,一些比較殘暴獵食性的雜食性的一些生物,他覺得烏鴉不好吃,.
這些是文化傳統遺留下來的一些價值,一些category,或者可能是一些宗教的category,在近東裡面,.
以色列人為什麼這麼強調不吃豬肉呢?不是因為public hygiene的問題,當然可能有些public hygiene的原因,.
以前古代他們煮東西可能煮不熟,所以不衛生等等,最主要是他們不喜歡吃豬肉,到今天還是不吃豬肉,原因很多時候都是宗教的問題,.
因為在近東的文化裡面有很多異教色彩的社會,他們是將豬獻給一些邪靈的,一些陰間的邪靈,所以他們覺得是一種不潔的東西,.
你怎麼煮都好,他們都不會吃的,所以有很多不同的因素,以至特定的文化,有他自己的食物的category,.
這段經文的分段其實很清楚,你看頭十九字,他分地上的活物,然後水裡面的活物,天上的活物,.
無論你覺得他們的食譜為什麼有些東西可以吃,有些東西不可以吃,原因在哪裡,我相信最大的原因,或者可以捕捉到這段聖經到底想教什麼,想講什麼,.
最主要其實就是他們想起天地海,他們的宇宙觀是分開三個level,天地與海,當你想到天地與海的時候,你會想起哪一段聖經,猶太人很熟的,.
創世記第一章,因為上帝創造萬有,整理萬有的時候,分開黑夜,白晝,全部東西分開的時候,就是在那六天裡面,創世記的第五和第六天,.
就將天地與海的活物創立出來,所以他們想起的就是他們對創造的神學,theology of creation,他們認為上帝創立這個世界的時候,有他的category,有他的類別,.
另外你看十一章的話,你就知道整個字會出現,除了那些類別的動物之外,就是類字,kind,category,這個字在整章十一章出現了很多次,.
最多出現這個字是什麼呢?就是經文,創世記第一章,創世記第一章,就是各從其類,上帝創立整頓這個世界的時候,去到分配不同種類的時候,就是各從其類,天上的飛鳥是各從其類,.
海裡面的魚也是各從其類,就是上帝有秩序,整整有條的去創立order,跟這個order的東西就是潔淨,不跟這個order的東西,我們就不知道他放在哪裡,那些我們就認為他們是不潔淨,所以這個是猶太人舊約裡面的神學,.
譬如說水裡面的魚,有什麼可以吃的呢?有什麼潔淨的呢?魚就是有刺有鱗的,一定是有刺有鱗的,你想一下,在水裡面游的東西,就應該要有刺有鱗,不然怎麼游呢?.
但偏偏有些東西在水裡面不是有刺有鱗的,但在水裡面游,那些叫鱔,有些其他蝦蟹等等,那些算不潔淨,為什麼?因為不屬於那個category,怎麼define呢?.
沒有刺沒有鱗,但又在水裡面住的,所以這個又是講到廣東話才有這麼全神的表達,其他語言都沒有,叫不頂不吊是什麼意思呢?.
什麼叫不頂不吊?就是你fit不進去那個category,所以就成為所謂不潔的東西,天上的飛鳥,你會發現他們有不同的雜性,鷹有不同的雜性,或者蝙蝠可能是很古怪的東西,很disgusting的東西,或者樣子很噁心的東西,所以就變成不潔淨,.
但是請你好像上個禮拜一樣,利未記去處理一些疫症的時候,我們不可以照字搬紙的,我們要想深一層,到底有些什麼神學的概念,有些什麼conviction,背後底下有些什麼深一層的ideology,是引發他們有這樣的看法,那個才是最重要的訊息,.
食物的條例我們不只是表面去看這些字,我們就說照辦主觀,今天不能吃的東西全部在這裡,那不就不行了,那你就不可以吃焗豬扒飯,不可以這樣照字搬紙,你要想一下他背後有什麼world view,而那個dietary law,那個飲食的條例,就是去表述一個世界觀,一個live view,怎樣去看世界,以往舊約的人就是這樣看世界,.
原因就是出自那個live view,那個世界觀是什麼呢,就是上帝是創造主,上帝是創立這個世界,真正生命的主權,終極生命的主權,像飲食那個,是上帝,不是你努力就可以拿回來,是上帝有主權去分配給你的,.
泥土,這個是一個很重要的宣告,就是說雖然我們人以為我們是萬物之靈,但是我們是沒有最大權的,創造主才有絕對的主權,.
你想一下你今天呼吸,都是創造主有的主權,大概兩個星期前,Coby Bryant,就一個空難就去世了,你上都沒有上過,人生就是這樣,一個的病症或者一個的疫症,就揭發了我們人生命其實是很脆弱的,.
我們很無力,在湖北有一個女孩子,她最近在網上發表了她的遺言,她睡在醫院裡,一個很年輕的女孩子,她很不甘心,.
父母或者親戚以為她是得救,聽從醫院的安排,其實她自己知道她快要死,沒有醫生來,沒有人問她,沒有人管她,心裡面很不忿,太多話已經不知道怎麼說了,.
我知道還有我這個人發病的人,然後死在這裡,肯定是不少,我們如此相信政府,現在落到這個結局,.
你看看生命是多麼脆弱,可能外在你會覺得有些事情很富強,可能有一個國家,一個大國,可能是可以看上去是戰無不勝,.

但其實我們很渺小,因為生命真的不是我們可以手去操縱,所以我們看到利未記,你可能覺得一些很無關痛癢的東西,今天我們不會照著利未記的食譜去吃東西,.

是在效法上帝,效法上帝做的事情,吃東西不吃什麼就是去到親近上帝,是他靈性的一部分,所以你看到這個食譜很強調某一樣東西,感覺你大概應該get到,.

seven deadly sins是什麼呢?有人甚至把現在的seven deadly sins放在online上面,seven deadly sins是什麼呢?七宗是致命的罪,第一是窒道,人家有的東西我沒有,我好窒道,第二是懶惰,不去being productive,不去生產,不去貢獻,.

就是說不管這麼多,三七二十一,總之我治了我的胃口,滿足我的食慾,那就算數,放縱我們的食慾,無限制地放縱,這個也是one of the seven deadly sins,.
你有沒有想過,你吃東西是你生命靈性的indicator,是表達你靈裡面的一個,你和上帝關係的一個指標,你試一下這樣想,I think我們就get到到底那個message在哪裡,那個食譜想講什麼,.
前幾年我認識一個白人的年青牧師,二十多歲的,剛剛上學院畢業,開始,牧會開始,港獨開始去帶人家,教導人家,有一次跟他吃飯,坐下來聊天,幾年前,.
大家說原來他很努力地在減肥,他真的很肥,他那種肥不是我們華人那種肥,那種肥是白人那種肥,你知道白人那種肥是,那些噸位很厲害,那些mini cooper他進不去,要買一些大的美國車才行,.
跟他聊天的時候,他說他很努力減肥,我跟他聊天的時候就問為什麼,我想他見到我的時候應該是很質度,很多牧師都很肥,我跟他聊天的時候我就問他為什麼,.

吃到自己身體有點差,負荷很大,當然負荷大,身體裡面的機能很大的負荷,overload,你美肌教人做什麼,.

10:1 & \begin{tabularx}{0.7\textwidth}{X} 在凱撒利亞有一個人名叫哥尼流，是意大利營的百夫長。 \end{tabularx} \\ \\ \relax
10:2 & \begin{tabularx}{0.7\textwidth}{X} 他是個虔誠人，他和全家都敬畏神。他多多賙濟百姓，常常向神禱告。 \end{tabularx} \\ \\ \relax
10:3 & \begin{tabularx}{0.7\textwidth}{X} 有一天，約在下午三點鐘，他在異象中清楚看見神的一個使者進來，到他那裡，對他說：「哥尼流。」 \end{tabularx} \\ \\ \relax
10:4 & \begin{tabularx}{0.7\textwidth}{X} 哥尼流定睛看他，驚惶地說：「主啊，甚麼事？」天使對他說：「你的禱告和你的賙濟已達到神面前，蒙記念了。 \end{tabularx} \\ \\ \relax
10:5 & \begin{tabularx}{0.7\textwidth}{X} 現在你要派人往約帕去，請一位稱為彼得的西門來。 \end{tabularx} \\ \\ \relax
10:6 & \begin{tabularx}{0.7\textwidth}{X} 他住在一個皮革匠西門的家裡，房子就在海邊。」 \end{tabularx} \\ \\ \relax
10:7 & \begin{tabularx}{0.7\textwidth}{X} 向他說話的天使離開後，哥尼流叫了兩個僕人和常伺候他的一個虔誠的兵來， \end{tabularx} \\ \\ \relax
10:8 & \begin{tabularx}{0.7\textwidth}{X} 把一切的事都講給他們聽，然後就派他們往約帕去。 \end{tabularx} \\ \\ \relax
10:9 & \begin{tabularx}{0.7\textwidth}{X} 第二天，他們走路將近那城，約在正午，彼得上房頂去禱告。 \end{tabularx} \\ \\ \relax
10:10 & \begin{tabularx}{0.7\textwidth}{X} 他覺得餓了，想要吃。那家的人正預備飯的時候，彼得魂遊象外， \end{tabularx} \\ \\ \relax
10:11 & \begin{tabularx}{0.7\textwidth}{X} 看見天開了，有一塊好像大布的東西降下，四角吊著縋在地上， \end{tabularx} \\ \\ \relax

joy..
Today, we're continuing on with this study we've been doing, looking at kingdom values.
that Jesus taught us in the Beatitudes, which is a part of the Sermon on the Mount in Matthew.
5..
And specifically, we're looking at verse 4 today, Matthew 5, verse 4, and it says this,.
"Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.".
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted..
Now this verse has a lot of really deep meaning for us and deep meaning for what it means.
to be a follower of Jesus, a disciple, for what it means to have a right relationship.
to God..
And in a really deep way, it tells us a lot about what it means to have a right relationship.
to the people around us and to the world around us..

$^{1}$Good morning family. Today, after a few months in Matthew chapter five,.
we are finishing out this chapter. Now it's not the end of the sermon on the.
mount. There's two more chapters of this sermon to go..
And so we're going to continue on with looking at the kingdom values that are.
found in this sermon. But we're closing out this chapter today..
And Jesus closes out this chapter with this amazing statement that he makes..
So we're going to look at in Matthew chapter five, verse 48..
It says this,.
you therefore must be perfect as your heavenly father is perfect..
Okay, so wait just a minute here. I want to make sure we read this right..
It sounds like this verse is saying that we're supposed to be perfect..
Like God is perfect. We're supposed to imitate God in holiness..
We can look at it again and that's pretty much exactly what it says..
You therefore must be perfect as your heavenly father is perfect..
Now what is going on here? This is an impossible command..
This is an impossible ask. This is an impossible request..
So what is Jesus saying in this verse?.
I want us to dig into this passage today and examine what Jesus is saying to us.
when he calls us to be perfect in the way that God is perfect..
First of all,.
this word for perfect in Greek is a word that means complete and lacking nothing.
or in need of nothing and it could also mean mature,.
but it also does mean perfect. So when we read it, we could say, well,.
maybe God's just calling us to be mature..
Maybe God's just calling us to be complete,.
totally equipped to serve him and follow him. Yeah, that's a part of it..
That's there, but we can't escape the straightforward reading of this verse..
It says we're supposed to be lighting holy lives and that is a really,.
really challenging statement for us..
And as we look at the passage that surrounds it,.
we see that it gets even more challenging..
Remember when we read verse 20 it says, for I tell you,.
unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees,.
you will never enter the kingdom of heaven..
That was the beginning of this section where Jesus talks about the old Testament.
law and our relationship to it. And in all these ways,.
when Jesus talks about our anger, when Jesus talks about our lust,.
when he talks about how we break our promises,.
when he talks about how we retaliate and take revenge on one another and all of.
these things that Jesus has listed for us in this section,.

$^{41}$he's demonstrated how we fall so short,.
how our righteousness is so short of God's standard..
It certainly doesn't exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees..
And those two statements,.
verse 20 and verse 48 that we read this morning kind of bracket this section..
Jesus starts the section by saying, listen,.
if you think you want to be good enough to please God,.
then your righteousness has to exceed the righteousness of the scribes and.
Pharisees. As we talked about before,.
he's basically saying your righteousness has to exceed an external conformance..
It has to be more than something superficial..
It has to be more than something that is just outward and just for other people.
to see. It has to be something real..
And then he closes out this section with verse 48,.
the last verse of chapter five where he says,.
you therefore must be perfect as your heavenly father is perfect..
So Jesus is setting the bar impossibly high for us..
He's setting the standard impossibly high for us,.
but he's doing that to help us see how much we need God's work in our life and.
to help us see that this is impossible without God's work in our heart and in.
our lives. Notice in this verse,.
Jesus doesn't call us to just be a little bit better than other people..
Look at verse 47 and verse 46. He says,.
for if you love those who love you, what reward do you have?.
Do not even the tax collectors do the same? And if you greet only your brothers,.
what more are you doing than others? Do not even the Gentiles do the same..
Jesus isn't saying, Hey guys,.
if you can just do a little better than the tax collectors,.
if you can just do a little better than the Gentiles,.
if you can just do a little better than the people who don't know God and the.
people who don't love God, if you could just do a little better than them,.
then you're doing great. No, he says,.
I want you to be perfect in the way that God is perfect..
That's the standard. Jesus also doesn't say, Hey,.
I just want you to be a little bit better than you were last week..
I want you to just improve a little bit and just become a little bit better than.
you were. If you can do a little bit better job than you were last week,.
then that's what I want from you as a, as a subject of the kingdom,.
as a disciple, as a, as a follower of Jesus,.
just be a little bit better than you were..

$^{81}$But Jesus doesn't give us that either. Jesus says, no,.
I want you to be like God. I want you to be like me..
I want you to live out the values of the kingdom and I want you to live them out.
in every area of your life. That's what Jesus calls us to..
Now that's something that we cannot do. It's impossible..
And the fact that it's impossible and the fact that Jesus calls us to it,.
even though it is impossible points to what Jesus wants for our lives..
See, Jesus doesn't just want to improve us..
He wants to live through us..
And that's a central truth of Christianity..
That's a central value of the kingdom..
It's a central reality of following Jesus is that Jesus doesn't just want to.
improve us. He wants to live through us..
A lot of times we get this wrong idea about our faith,.
about being a Christian and about the Bible..
And we think that the Bible is kind of like a self help manual and it's a self.
improvement book and it's there to help us be a little bit better version of.
ourselves. It's there to turn us into me 2.0..
That's a little bit better than I was last week or last year, whatever..
Well, there's a little bit of truth in that. Yes,.
God is working in our life over time. Yes, it's a gradual process. Yes,.
we grow in small steps. And so it's a week at a time. It's a day at a time..
It's a year at a time. Yes, that's true..
But the reality is Jesus teaches us clearly in the scripture..
He doesn't want us to be me 2.0..
He doesn't want us to be a slightly improved version of ourselves..
That's not what he's trying to grow us towards..
He is trying to grow us towards his life in us..
He wants us to go away..
He wants us to disappear and he wants to live his life through us..
In Matthew chapter 16 verses 24 and 25 it says this,.
then Jesus told his disciples, if anyone would come after me,.
let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow me..
For whoever would save his life will lose it..
But whoever loses his life for my sake will find it..
And when we hear the word cross, we think of Jesus's death on the cross..
And we think of something beautiful. We think of our redemption..
But when Jesus said this to the disciples, the cross had not yet happened..
So they didn't think of redemption. When they heard the word cross,.
they thought of what it meant to them..

$^{121}$And to them it was an instrument of torture and death..
They had seen people crucified by the Romans. They knew what the cross meant..
And so when Jesus said, take up your cross to them,.
they understood that he was saying, listen,.
I want for your life to disappear..
I want for those natural things, those sinful things,.
all those old pieces of you to die and to be gone so that I can live through you..
That's what Jesus is calling us to. He doesn't just want to improve us..
He wants to live through us. He wants all that old sinful stuff,.
everything from verse 20 down to verse 48 that Jesus called out in our lives,.
the anger, the hatred, the lying, the broken promises,.
the lust, the retribution and revenge, and the way we treat other people..
All of that. Jesus is calling all that stuff out and he says, Hey,.
I want that stuff to be gone. I want that stuff to die..
I want it to encounter the cross,.
to encounter the instrument of death so that I can begin to live through you in.
the place of all your selfishness and all your sin and all your brokenness and.
all the ugly stuff,.
all the ways that you hurt one another and all the ways that you reject God..
I want those things to be gone so that I can live through you..
And that's what Jesus is pointing us to in this passage..
He's helping us to see that our righteousness has to exceed this righteousness.
of the scribes and Pharisees and that he wants us to live and in a way that is.
imitating God, that is imitating Christ..
It's not enough just to try to do a little bit better..
It's not enough just to try to be better than someone else..
Jesus wants us to completely disappear and he wants to live through us..
God wants to see less and less of me every day and more and more of Jesus every.
day. And in your life, God wants to see less and less of you every day..
Less and less of your pride. Less and less of your selfishness,.
less and less of your anger, less and less of your lust..
And he wants to see more and more of Jesus in your life every day..
More of Jesus's love, more of Jesus's care for others,.
more of Jesus's selflessness in your life,.
more of Jesus's self sacrificing love..
That's what God wants in my life and in your life..
Now, how does that happen?.
If we say, okay, that's what Jesus is telling us in this passage..
How does that happen? When we see this standard,.
when Jesus sets the standard impossibly high,.

$^{161}$there's a few ways that we can react to it..
One is to go to a place of despair and say,.
I can't meet that standard. I'm a bad person..
I'm a failure and I'm just going to live in despair..
That's not what God has for us..
Jesus doesn't put the standard out there to make us feel bad and to discourage.
us and to put us in a place of despair..
The other thing that we often do,.
and this is what Jesus actually talks about in Matthew chapter six,.
this is the last verse of chapter five..
But when we start talking about chapter six, next week, we'll see this..
Jesus begins chapter six by talking about hypocrisy..
And that's the other response. When we see how high the standard is,.
sometimes we respond by saying, well,.
I'm going to go ahead and pretend that I meet the standard, even though I don't,.
I'm going to try to just do my best and act like I do and tell other people that.
I do. And when we do that, we become a hypocrite..
We start acting like we're something we're not..
We start acting like we're, we're perfect and we never could be perfect..
That's hypocrisy..
But the way Jesus wants us to respond to this is through surrender to him,.
through saying, God, I can't live this out..
I can't exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees. God,.
there's certainly no way I can be perfect as my heavenly father is perfect..
I cannot do this. And so I'm going to let myself disappear..
I'm going to take all those old, selfish,.
sinful parts of me to the cross and let them die there and surrender to Jesus so.
that he can live through me..
And surrender is a choice..
I said that last week that nothing changes until you make a choice and we have.
to choose to surrender. We have to choose to say, God,.
I'm going to stop trying. I'm going to stop saying,.
maybe if I just try a little bit harder,.
maybe if I just figure out a few more things about the Bible,.
maybe if I just wrap my head around it or maybe if I just try to be a better.
person or maybe if I just work harder at hiding my sin from other people..
No..
When we stop all of that stuff and say, I'm going to surrender to you..
God, I can't do this..
I'm asking you to come and to live through me and to do this in my life..

$^{201}$I really can't think of a better way to express what this surrender looks like.
than the words of Jesus in another sermon that he gave..
And this is in the book of John in chapter 15..
Jesus is talking about abiding in him,.
surrendering to him, giving up so that he lives through us..
And he's talking about the peace and the rest and the joy that we find in that..
So I'm going to read this. This is John chapter 15 verses one to 11..
Jesus says, I am the true vine and my father is the vine dresser..
Every branch in me that does not bear fruit, he takes away..
And every branch that does bear fruit, he prunes that it may bear more fruits..
Already you are clean because of the word that I have spoken..
You abide in me and I in you as the branch cannot bear fruit by itself unless it.
abides in the vine. Neither can you, unless you abide in me. I am the vine..
You are the branches. Whoever abides in me and I in him,.
he it is that bears much fruit for apart from me, you can do nothing..
If anyone does not abide in me,.
he is thrown away like a branch and withers and the branches are gathered,.
thrown into the fire and burned. If you abide in me and my words abide in you,.
ask whatever you wish and it will be done for you. By this,.
my father is glorified that you bear much fruit and so prove to be my disciples..
As the father has loved me, so have I loved you abide in my love..
If you keep my commandments,.
you will abide in my love just as I have kept my father's commandments and abide.
in his love. These things I have spoken to you that my joy may be in you and that.
your joy may be full..
What a beautiful description of what it looks like to surrender to Jesus..
And Jesus is clear here in verses three and four. He's talking to his followers..
He's talking to his disciples. He's talking to the people of God,.
the subjects of the kingdom, those who already have relationship with him..
He's talking to you and me. We see that in verse three. He says,.
already you are clean because of the word that I have spoken to you..
He's talking to those of us who already know Jesus. We've already been cleansed..
We've had our sins forgiven. And then in verse four, he says,.
abide in me and I in you as the branch cannot bear fruit by itself unless it.
abides in the vine. Neither can you, unless you abide in me. I am the vine..
You are the branches. Jesus is saying he's the main stock..
He's the roots and the stock of the tree. And we're just the branches..
We can't do it on our own. He says that in the passage, apart from him,.
we can do nothing. But if we will surrender to him,.
and let him live through us,.

$^{241}$then beautiful things will start to happen in our lives..
Beautiful fruit will start to come. And that's what Jesus is calling us to..
He says that if we're abiding in him, then we will keep his commandments..
We will do what he has for us. So maybe you say, okay, what does that look like?.
If I believe that I can't be perfect, that's my heavenly father is perfect,.
that I have to surrender to Jesus in order to do that,.
that I have to start to disappear, that he has to start to live through me..
But what does that look like? How do I even do that? Well,.
the first step is to pray, to talk to God and say, God,.
I want to turn it over to you. I want to surrender to you..
I know I can't do it. I need you in my life. Please take control..
Please begin to live through me. Please begin to bring about fruit in my life..
That's the first step is just to, to ask and to,.
to confess your surrender to God..
But then what does it look like in the day to day of our lives? Well,.
it begins to look like surrendering to these values of the kingdom that we've.
been talking about over the last few months. Instead of saying,.
I'm going to live out my life according to my own values..
I'm going to live out my life in the ways that I think are best..
I'm going to surrender to the values of God's word,.
to the values that Jesus has taught me, to the values of the kingdom..
And I'm going to seek to live those out..
A great starting point is the ones that we've covered in the beatitudes..
Let's think about those for a second..
Blessed are the poor in spirit for theirs is the kingdom of heaven..
Surrendering to that saying, God,.
I'm not going to live from a place of pride or from a place of seeking my own.
righteousness. I'm, I want to be poor in spirit..
I want to understand how much I need you. I want to live from that place..
Blessed are the meek for they shall inherit the earth. Surrendering to saying,.
God, I don't want to live from a place of thinking I'm better than someone else..
I want my own understanding of my poverty of spirit to cause me to treat.
everyone else with love and respect because the rate made in your image..
And I know I'm just as broken as anyone else..
And I'm going to surrender to living out that value instead of trying to live.
from a place of pride and trying to assert myself and trying to give myself.
advantage over others. I'm going to be meek..
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness for they shall be.
satisfied. Saying, God, I'm, I'm going to surrender to that value. I'm,.
I'm going to stop hungering and thirsting after all the stuff of the world,.

$^{281}$all the stuff that I, that I crave because of my sin,.
all of the money or the power or the popularity or the lust or whatever those.
things are. God,.
I want to stop living for those things and I want to hunger and thirst after.
righteousness. I want to surrender to that..
Blessed are the merciful for they shall obtain mercy. God,.
I want to live in a way that I see the brokenness of others and that it breaks.
my heart. God, I want to surrender to that value..
Blessed are the pure in heart for they shall see God. God,.
I want to surrender to having a single minded desire towards knowing you and.
stop being distracted by everything else in the world and stop being.
contaminated by all these other desires and all these other things I want..
But God, I want to surrender to only desiring you..
That's hard because our heart wants, our flesh wants everything else..
We want this and that we want to achieve. We want to be comfortable..
We want to have things. We want to be wealthy..
We want all these different things. But can we surrender to saying, God,.
I want the purity of my heart to be found and only desiring you..
Blessed are the peacemakers for they shall be called the sons of God..
Can we surrender to that and say, God,.
I want to live a life that brings Shalom into the lives of others and the verses.
10 to 12 that talk about being persecuted for righteousness sake. God,.
I want to surrender to that..
I want to surrender to the fact that if I'm following you,.
there's going to be people who are uncomfortable with that,.
that it might bring about some persecution and I'm going to live it out anyway..
And I'm, I don't want to give up when things are difficult and following you..
That's a great starting point in surrendering to the values of the kingdom..
Start with the beatitudes..
And then as you continue to know God's word and study the scripture,.
you'll see more and more values of the kingdom that God wants you to surrender.
to as you continue to follow Jesus and learn more about him and deepen your.
relationship with him..
God will open up more and more of his truth and you'll see more and more things.
that you can surrender to more and more things about you and your,.
your selfishness and the old part of you that can pass away, that can die,.
that can disappear..
And more and more of Jesus that can come in and live through you..
And that's what Jesus is saying in this verse when he says,.
be perfect as your heavenly father is perfect..

$^{321}$He's not saying that we're going to try hard enough to do this..
He's saying there's no way you can do it. You've got to surrender..
You've got to abide. You've got to let Jesus do it through you..
You've got to let him live his life through your life..
He doesn't want to improve us and make us a little bit better..
He wants to radically transform us so that he is living in our place..
He is living through us. So let's live into this..
Let's be honest that we're not going to be good enough on our own,.
that we're not going to try hard enough to be all that God wants us to be or.
even to be all that we want to be ourselves..
But we have got to have God's help. We've got to have God's work in our life..
We've got to have the empowerment of the Holy Spirit in our life..
And the reality is that that's what God wants all along..
God never wanted us to do it. God never expected us to do it..
God wants us to disappear, to fade away..
He wants our selfishness, our pride,.
all the things about us that have driven our decisions and charted our course.
before we knew Jesus..
God wants those things to fade away and he wants Jesus to begin living through.
us..
God wants us to surrender to Jesus and let him live his life through us..
God wants us to surrender to the values of the kingdom and say, God,.
I want to live out the values of the kingdom instead of just trying to live out.
the things that are important to me, the things that I value,.
the things that the culture around me values..
I want to live out your values in my life. I want to prioritize those things..
God wants us to surrender to relationship with him and say, God,.
I'm going to prioritize knowing you over everything else in my life..
God wants us to surrender to abiding and saying, God,.
I can't do this on my own apart from you..
I really can't do anything..
So I'm going to rest and I'm going to let you live through me so that I can be.
who you want me to be..
That's what God calls us to and that's what Jesus is pointing us to in this.
chapter..
And we have to cry out to God and ask God to help us to do it..
And we have to ask God to give us the courage and the strength to surrender and.
the courage and the strength to step out of the way and let Jesus live through.
us. So let's do that. We'll do it right now,.
but let's continue to do that over this week..

$^{361}$Let's continue to ask God to be at work in our life,.
to ask God to give us the strength and courage to surrender over and over to.
continue to surrender,.
to make that journey of surrendering to Christ and being closer to.
him and becoming more and more like Jesus and more and more of who God wants us.
to be. Let's pray. God, we do just profess our need for you. God,.
we know that we cannot be who you want us to be or even who we want to be.
on our own without your help. And so God, we just cry out for your help..
We ask you to give us the strength to surrender to you and God,.
I pray that we would do it..
I pray that we would surrender to the values of your kingdom and that we would.
live out what's important to you,.
that we have prioritized the things that you prioritize. And God,.
I pray that we would surrender to orienting our lives around you and really.
focusing everything on you and focusing everything on our relationship to you,.
God. And as we do that, God, we ask for you to live through us..
May your love shine through us. May your peace shine through us..
May your unselfishness and your selflessness shine through us..
May your humility shine through us. God,.
may you live through us so that we ourselves, but more importantly,.
the people around us see less and less of us and more and more of Jesus in our.
lives. God, our world needs that so bad..
Our world so badly needs to see more and more of Jesus..
May we be your people and may we be the people who,.
who live that out, who show more and more of Jesus to our friends,.
our families, our community, our city, and to the world around us. God,.
In Jesus' name, Amen..

\label{sec:Lh5hqFxfj84}
\textbf{Kingdom Values XXVI: Matthew Chapter 6 Continued - Pastor Sam Johnson}
\newline
\newline
連結: \href{https://youtube.com/watch?v=Lh5hqFxfj84}{\texttt{https://youtube.com/watch?v=Lh5hqFxfj84}} ~~~~ 語音日期: 2020-10-19
